author: yuzi.kpharmacist
caption: Using Medicube Zero Pore Pads? 🫧 Read the 7 MUST RULEs first 👇 These are NOT just toner pads. They have exfoliating acids that clean out your pores. So yes… there are rules 😅 1️⃣ Start with 2–3 nights a week Every night is too much at first. 2️⃣ Swipe gently. Don't scrub. Let the pad do the work, not your hands. 3️⃣ Use it on DRY skin Wet skin can sting more. 4️⃣ Skip your eyes and lips That skin is thin 👀 5️⃣ No retinol on the same night Acids + retinol together = too much. 6️⃣ Sunscreen the next morning ☀️ Always. No skipping. 7️⃣ Burning? Stop & rinse off 🚿 A little tingle is okay. Red, hot, burning skin is NOT okay. 📌 Save this before your next pad night! Which rule did you NOT know?
